create_bullet_manipulator_env: create a BulletManipulatorEnv instance with a robot model config and PyBullet GUI or DIRECT mode
load_robot_from_urdf: load a robot URDF file into the PyBullet simulation using load_robot_description_from_urdf
apply_joint_torques: apply a numpy array of torques to robot joints with optional gravity compensation
compute_forward_kinematics: compute the end-effector position and orientation quaternion from given joint positions
compute_inverse_kinematics: compute joint positions that satisfy a target end-effector position and orientation
